name: comfy-story-planner
description: Turn a film idea into a continuity-aware shot plan, validate exact timing, compile candidate prompts and export authored dialogue as SRT.

interface.longDescription: Turn a film idea into a continuity-aware shot plan, validate exact timing, compile candidate prompts and export authored dialogue as SRT. Uses original Comfy Story contracts. No GPU needed for planning; does not render video or verify visual continuity. Requires Python 3.11+ and a host with file and shell access.
defaultPrompt: Plan a 12-second film about lending a key, with three shots and consistent ownership.
Check my film plan for timing and continuity errors.
Export the dialogue in my film plan as timed SRT subtitles.

publication.release_notes: Initial portable release with source-pinned tools, workflow skills, examples and verification.

review.commerce_description: Free distribution. No purchases, subscriptions or payment collection in this plugin. Host software may have separate costs.
